lines.1: Yes, this would do. I checked it out.
lines.3: 「Joint running practice with the track team... is rather... demanding.」
lines.4: 「What's wrong, martial arts club? You're out of breath.」
lines.5: 「Do not compare me to a natural-born runner.」
lines.8: 「Probably for the club bulletin or something. The captain gave her permission, so there's no problem.」
lines.9: 「She is taking far too many of me.」
lines.13: 「No, this is not self-consciousness. She is clearly photographing me.」
lines.14: 「What's wrong with that? You're loved, aren't you?」
lines.15: The people around them started jeering, 'Look at you go, Yohei!'
lines.19: 「Forget the greeting. What is the meaning of this, Nishizaki?」
lines.21: 「You do not need to photograph only me.」
lines.23: 「When... Yohei's working hard... it makes... a good picture...」
lines.24: 「You are distracting me. It is a nuisance.」
lines.27: 「Hey, what was that reaction?! Getting teased by everyone is no excuse to act like a child, Yohei-chan.」
lines.28: 「Hmph. That will not discourage her. The fact remains that she distracts me.」
